Window Film
landscape.say: Thinking about window tinting in Miami? Here's a look at Miami Window Film Pros, what they install, and why window film makes sense here.

landscape.label: Why Window Film Here
landscape.title: Why Window Film Matters in Miami's Year-Round Sun
landscape.say: Most American cities get a break from cooling for part of the year. Miami barely does. The dry season from roughly November to April is milder and less humid, but sunny afternoons still push indoor temperatures up on any glass that faces the sun.

landscape.say: For homes: Privacy: Frosted, mirrored and gradient finishes for bathrooms, ground-floor bedrooms and condos that face straight into the next tower. Decorative: Etched, striped and patterned films for front-door glass, sidelights, shower enclosures and interior partitions. Security: Heavy clear film that holds a cracked pane together and makes it slower to push through sliders, French doors and ground-floor windows. Glare Reduction: Takes the edge off reflections on TVs, monitors and tile floors in rooms facing the water or a bright street, without closing the blinds on the view you paid for.

landscape.say: For businesses: Decorative & Frosted Glass: Frosted bands, full frost, cut-out logos and patterns for clinic windows, glass office fronts and suite doors, with crisp edges and clean removal when the lease is up. Solar Control: Heat and glare rejection on big commercial glass, from curtain-wall towers to warehouse offices in Doral, selected after they know what glazing is already in the frames. Conference Room Privacy: Frosted or patterned film on glass meeting rooms so slides, whiteboards and faces are hidden from the hallway. Low-E: For older Miami buildings with single-pane glass, low-emissivity film trims solar heat and helps hold conditioned air indoors, at a fraction of the disruption of new windows.

landscape.say: Common questions: Will my condo association allow window film? Most Miami associations accept interior film that leaves the facade looking unchanged, though nearly all want to see it first. How long does window film last in Miami sun? Interior film on home and office glass usually lasts many years, and the film maker's warranty states the term. How many days does new film need to cure in Miami? Usually several days to a few weeks.

landscape.label: Local Know-How
landscape.title: Hurricane Season and Security Window Film in Miami
landscape.say: Hurricane season runs from June 1 to November 30, and after Hurricane Andrew in 1992 Miami-Dade adopted some of the strictest building requirements in the country. Openings in the county's High-Velocity Hurricane Zone are protected with impact windows or shutters that carry product approval. Window film is not part of that system.

landscape.label: How It Works
landscape.title: How an install works

tiles.s: On site they identify the glazing
Leftover moisture under the film has to escape before it

landscape.say: Here's how an install works. First, list the windows, rough sizes and the direction each one faces on the quote form, and note whether any of them sit above the ground floor. Then, on site they identify the glazing (single-pane, insulated, laminated or impact), look for failing seals, and put samples on the real glass. On install day, floors and sills get covered, every pane is cleaned, and the film is trimmed to the frame edge and pressed flat with a squeegee. Finally, leftover moisture under the film has to escape before it reaches full clarity.
